decision_conditions: <p>The following is to be provided to and approved by the Local Planning Authority within two months of the date of this approval:<br>a) A full photographic and scaled drawing (1:10 or 1:20) measured record of all the various items of historic painted text on the north, south and west elevation walls behind the dry lining in the storeroom kitchen, which will require full or partial removal of modern plasterboard as appropriate.</p><p>b) Following completion of part A, details for the installation of vision panels and interpretation board required for the historic painted text behind the dry-lining in the storeroom kitchen.</p><p><br></p>

<p>All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.<br><br></p>

<p>The following works are required to be undertaken within 4 months of the date of this approval and retained as such thereafter:</p><p>a) re-instating the two panelled doors from the store room to their pre-existing locations on the first floor,</p><p>b) covering air conditioning units with a timber slatted cover,</p><p>c) recording and revealing historic writing in the storeroom kitchen, and installing an interpretation panel.</p><p><br></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p>Suitable precautions shall be taken to secure and protect features against accidental loss or damage during the building work hereby granted, and no such features may be disturbed or removed, temporarily or permanently, except as indicated on the approved drawings or with the prior approval in writing of the local planning authority.<br><br></p>

<p>If previously unknown evidence is discovered about historic character which would be affected by the works hereby granted, an appropriate record, together with recommendations for dealing with it in the context of the scheme, shall be approved in writing by the local planning authority before any of the permitted works are begun. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.<br><br></p>
